title: Lava Floor Penguins
hook: Penguins on slippery ice, lava waves rolling in, fish everywhere. Slide, grab, and shove your friends into the lava.

theme.keyArtPrompt: Cheerful round penguins sliding and bumping on cracked ice tiles while glowing orange lava waves roll across, shiny fish flying everywhere, bold shapes, no text

sprites.player: round penguin with a scarf, top-down cartoon
sprites.lava: bubbling orange lava blob with a warning glow, top-down cartoon
sprites.tile: cracked square ice floe tile, top-down cartoon

timeline.hostLine: Uh oh. The volcano sneezed! Something new is coming, eyes up!
A golden fish! Worth triple! Go go go!
The ice is cracking! Get to the middle, penguins!

host.intro: The floor is ice, the waves are lava, and penguins cannot brake. Grab fish, dodge waves, and shove your friends!
host.finale: Final ten! Fish count DOUBLE and the ice is falling apart. Waddle for your lives!
host.tutorial: Stick to slide (it's icy!). Grab fish. Dodge the glowing lava waves. Tap DASH to shove a penguin into the lava for bonus points!
